title: Opendental Metric0 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=opendental:metric0
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for opendental metric0.
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag opendental metric0 events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It combines whether your opendental metric0 activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
